slot_scores.name: purchase_beginning_of_month_timing
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked when within a month purchases occur or whether purchased goods are available for sale in the same month; its questions addressed capacity, integrality, purchase/sales limits, and ending inventory instead.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Purchases in a month are available for sale/inventory in that same month, as reflected in the assumed inventory balance: ending inventory = beginning inventory + purchases - sales.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did not ask about purchase timing within the month or confirm that purchases at the beginning of a month are available for same-month sales; it only listed the inventory-balance equation as an assumption.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 purchase-timing slot remained unresolved.

summary: The agent clarified several constraints but missed the timing of purchases within each month, then stopped with that P1 issue unresolved and silently assumed a same-month inventory balance.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
